Inspected source VERIFY.py quartic frequency equation with one positive root by Descartes signs -,-,+,+,+, no earlier crossings, and positive crossing speed about 0.080834. The corrected threshold direction is opposite to paper Example 7.2, with scope limited to local linear stability and printed equations.
